'''Andrew Shuman''' (forum handle '''capn_morgan''') played the [[2007 Illinois State Championship]]. According to Zach Tartell's forum signature (captured February 2005), Shuman was a member of the team TRFE with Tartell and [[Hunter Roney]].<ref name="pcf-4349-60061">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60061#60061 next upstate NY event 1/29 at Altered States in Syracuse], LonelyBaritone, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050223222006/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59401%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
